summary: FASE 2 CMS tested end-to-end via Playwright on public preview URL. Login admin -> Cabina di Regia -> edited Home sections (hide bnb, change featured title, reorder buyers), Navbar (brand=SUPREME TEST, hid nav-item-1=Immobili), Footer (phone/email/social instagram). Reloaded public site: all changes reflected (bnb absent, featured new title present, brand updated, Immobili hidden from navbar, footer contacts and socials visible). Defaults restored successfully at end: bnb visible again, brand=SUPREME HOUSE, featured title 'Immobili & Aste piu visti', all nav items visible, footer phone/email/socials cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: Hub.jsx DEFAULT_ORDER duplicated between frontend and backend seed_extra.py DEFAULT_HOME.order; consider single source of truth to avoid drift.
HomeEditor move() does not persist new order visually when reorder uses stale index -- works but relies on React re-render; fine for current UX.
Navbar accountTab testid is identical ('nav-accedi') across logged-in/out states; could cause selector ambiguity in future tests.
seed_data_creation: None (test modified settings then restored defaults)
